examples.english: A bullet hit and made a hole in the wall.

notes:
{玉|たま} refers to round objects, gems, or balls. The kanji can also be read as ぎょく in some compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{目玉|めだま}→目玉：13649_medama⟧: eyeball
- ⟦{玉子|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: egg (also written ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧)
- ⟦{玉|たま}ねぎ→玉葱：05196_tamanegi⟧: onion
- ⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧: polka dots, water droplet
- ⟦{玉入|たまい}れ→玉入れ：28110_tamaire⟧: ball-toss game
- ⟦{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}→百円玉：28167_hyakuendama⟧: 100-yen coin

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {玉|たま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{瑕|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: a fly in the ointment (lit. a flaw in a gem)
- {玉|たま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ような→ような：noentry⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: flawless skin (lit. skin like a gem)

PRONUNCIATION:
- たま: native Japanese reading (round object, ball)
- ぎょく: Sino-Japanese reading in ⟦{玉座|ぎょくざ}→玉座：noentry⟧ (throne), ⟦{宝玉|ほうぎょく}→宝玉：noentry⟧ (jewel)

USAGE:
Can refer to bullets (⟦{鉄砲玉|てっぽうだま}→鉄砲玉：noentry⟧) in informal speech.
